Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The adult permit paragraph tells readers to see Chapter 9 for road test scheduling, but the manual's table of contents ends at Chapter 8; the dossier does not repeat that cross-reference [A02] (verify MN-GDL-D-CHAPTER).
The fee and tax exemption paragraph for veterans with a total service-connected disability is printed on two consecutive pages with the same content; the dossier records it once [A07] [A08].
The veteran indicator heading contains a spelling slip in the manual; the dossier uses the correct word and the content is unaffected [A07].
Commercial license classes, endorsements and motor carrier rules are kept as continuation facts in part C2 because they appear in this chapter, although the Class D written test centres on the regular license.
